aboutHead.title: About FreshCart
aboutHead.intro: A neighbourhood store, buying direct and pricing honestly.

blocks.text: FreshCart began as a single counter on Market Road stocking rice, dal and cooking oil. What our customers actually wanted, it turned out, was somewhere they could finish the whole week's shop without a second stop — so we grew into the aisles you see now.
Buying direct

Our fruit and vegetables come from growers inside the district, delivered to us the morning after picking. Cutting out the intermediate market is why produce here is fresher and usually cheaper than the chains — not because we squeeze the farmer.
Pricing you can check

The shelf price is the price you pay. Where a bulk pack genuinely costs less per kilo we will tell you, and where it does not — spices, cooking oil, biscuits — we will tell you that too, even though the smaller pack earns us less.
Knowing the stock
Everyone on the floor can tell you which cereal suits an eight-month-old, which rice holds up in a biryani, and what came in this morning. That is the part a bigger shop cannot copy.

items.title: Say when it isn't worth it
items.text: If the bulk pack won't save you money, or the produce isn't good today, we say so.

items.title: Buy local first
items.text: Forty growers within the district supply our fresh counter. We pay them weekly, not on ninety-day terms.

items.title: Waste as little as possible
items.text: Produce is marked down at two days and donated at three. Very little leaves this shop as rubbish.

items.title: Label honestly
items.text: Dates on the shelf edge, origin on the crate, and no repackaging to hide an old batch.

blocks.text: This page explains what this website collects, why, and what we do with it. It is written to be read rather than to be legally exhaustive — if anything is unclear, ring the store and ask.
What this website stores
Your shopping list and your light/dark preference are saved in your own browser's local storage. They never leave your device and we cannot see them. Clearing your browser data removes them.
What we collect when you contact us
If you submit the contact form or subscribe to the newsletter, we receive what you typed — typically your name, phone number, email and message. We use it to reply to you and nothing else.
Analytics
This site ships with analytics switched off and loads no tracking scripts by default. If that changes, this section will say which provider is in use before it is enabled.
Third parties
Images on this site are served from Unsplash, and fonts from Google Fonts. Those providers see your IP address as part of serving the file, as they would on any site that uses them.
Getting your data removed
Email or ring us and we will delete any enquiry or subscription record we hold for you. There is no account to close.
By using this website you accept the terms below.
Prices and availability

Prices shown here are updated weekly and are a guide. Fresh produce moves with the market, so the price at the counter may differ — we will always tell you before billing. Stock shown as available is not reserved until we confirm an order.
Orders
An order is confirmed when we acknowledge it by phone or message, not when you send it. We may decline or limit an order — for example on bulk quantities during a shortage.
Returns

Unopened non-perishable goods may be returned within 7 days with the bill. Fresh produce, dairy and bakery items cannot be returned once they have left the store, for food safety reasons. This does not affect your rights where goods are faulty.
Content on this site
Recipes, storage advice and shopping lists here are general guidance. They are not dietary or medical advice — if you have a condition or an allergy, check with a professional.
Accuracy
We keep this site as accurate as we can, but we cannot guarantee it is free of errors. If you spot something wrong, telling us is genuinely helpful.
